limitations: Passive symmetric reciprocal monochromatic two-flux model only; no refractive discontinuities, thermal emission, wavelength crossings, angular effects, or broader radiative transfer guarantee. Literature priority for the all-order sorting criterion remains provisional; the intrinsic ratio appeared already in Kubelka 1954 for three-sheet transmittance.
scientific_integrity: The reflected diffuse two-flux flux ordering is proved by an exact adjacent-swap matrix identity. Numerically verified examples are only checks, not proof. Original Kubelka layering and intrinsic index are explicitly credited.
title: Universal layer-order rule for two-flux atmospheric reflectance
